text: dsh-plugin-recursive-harness 是面向 DSH 的 agent harness 演进插件，会把当前 harness 挂载到系统提示，并在新 Session 创建时载入最新版本。用户可用 /harness 命令检查状态、启动任务、查看进度、取消运行、回退版本和查看跨任务经验。演进流程对任务执行参考探针，比较候选后决定是否采用，并将经验整理成可供后续任务参考的条目。它适合希望迭代 DSH 提示词、工具指导、长期记忆和技能的开发者；默认使用固定模板提案器，配置为 LLM 时可接 OpenAI 兼容端点。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness evolves DSH prompts, memory, and skills for new sessions. Use /harness to start tasks, inspect or cancel runs, roll back versions, and view experience. Probes compare proposed changes. A fixed template proposer is default; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint is optional.
想让 DSH 根据任务探针逐步改进 agent 的提示词和技能。
如何查看当前会话使用的 harness 版本和已挂载技能？
I want to compare prompt or tool guidance variants on tasks and keep the better harness version.
dsh-plugin-recursive-harness 的功能「任务驱动演进」：输入任务 ID 或任务文件，通过 /harness start 启动提案与探针比较；采用的版本会更新挂载内容。
dsh-plugin-recursive-harness 的功能「状态与版本管理」：用 /harness inspect、status、cancel、rollback 查看状态、停止任务或恢复版本；listExperience 查看经验。
dsh-plugin-recursive-harness 设为 llm 提案模式时，会将任务提示、当前 harness 和执行摘要发往配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点；默认 template 模式不调用提案端点。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · Recursive Harness：English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md)

A plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) that evolves the agent's **harness** while the model weights stay frozen, following the two-level recursion of Google Research's **Harness²** ([arXiv:2610.14224](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224)):

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · Recursive Harness：- **Per task: Propose → Probe → Compose.** A model proposes two candidate harnesses (a *general* one that sharpens reasoning and tool discipline, and a *domain* one that adds memory, guardrails and a skill). Each candidate runs in an isolated headless dsh with a copy of the task workspace. Objective checks decide first, behavioral metrics (tool errors, steps, tokens) second, an optional model judge last. Complementary winners are merged and verified again; a worse merge falls back to the best single candidate.
- **Across tasks: Reflector → Experience Library.** What worked and what failed is written as plain Markdown entries that later proposals can draw on, in strict time order.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · Recursive Harness：What gets evolved: four system prompt sections (`systemprompt`, `guardrails`, `tool_guidance`, `longTermMemory`) and candidate skills (`SKILL.md` plus small scripts). What never changes: your `AGENTS.md`, `.dsh/`, `.git/`, and anything you list in `lockedSurfaces`.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · Recursive Harness：**Status: experimental.** It works end to end on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, and the evaluation in [`docs/evaluation-report.md`](docs/evaluation-report.md) was run with a real model on a 12-task synthetic set. Read the report's limitations before expecting gains on your own tasks.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · What you see：1. Install the plugin. Every new Session now carries the active harness version (four sections once each in the system prompt; `/harness inspect` shows the version and the mounted skills).
2. `/harness start gen-dev-01` (a built-in task) or `/harness start ./my-task.mjs` starts an evolution run in the background: reference runs, proposals, probes, comparison, compose. `/harness status <runId>` follows it; `/harness cancel <runId>` stops it and kills the child processes.
3. When a candidate beats the baseline on the objective checks and by more than the baseline's own variance, it becomes the active version. **New Sessions** get it; running Sessions are never changed mid-flight. `/harness rollback [versionId]` goes back.
4. `/harness listExperience` lists what the reflector kept.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · What you see：The same commands exist on the command line: `npx dsh-recursive-harness inspect | start | status | cancel | rollback | listExperience` (state under `./.dsh-harness` by default; `--config` takes a JSON file with the same keys as the plugin settings).

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Requirements：- dsh 0.2.x. Tested on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (Windows 11, Node.js 24.21) with the web profile; probes use the headless profile that ships with dsh.
- Node.js 22.19 or later in the 22 line, or 24 and later (the same as dsh).
- A **proposer endpoint**: any OpenAI-compatible chat completions server (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama, or a hosted API). Until you configure one, the proposer is a fixed template and no text leaves your machine.
- Probes run with the model of the profile you name in `probe.templateProfile` (default `web`), or with `probe.provider` / `probe.model` if you set them. Each probe is a full agent run; budget accordingly.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness
```

Through npx: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`. Restart `dsh web`. The plugin prints `[recursive-harness] ready: …` on start.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Install：**Update:** `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`, then restart. dsh installs plugins with pnpm, which picks a newly published version only once it is a day old; to update right away, name the version (`add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness@0.1.0`).

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Install：To remove: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`, delete the `recursive-harness` entry from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` if you added one, and delete `~/.dsh/recursive-harness/` if you do not want to keep the harness versions and the experience library.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Settings：Settings go in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (web profile: `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). An entry with `id: recursive-harness` replaces the plugin's whole `config`; keys you leave out keep the defaults in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml).

```yaml
- id: recursive-harness
  config:
    proposer:
      engine: llm

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Your own tasks：A task file is an ES module that exports a task (or `tasks`, an array). The plugin writes `workspaceFiles` into an empty workspace, runs the agent with `prompt`, and hands the final output to `objectiveCheck`:

```js
// my-task.mjs
export default {
  taskId: 'orders-report',
  split: 'dev',

The proposer never sees `expected`; the numbers in `details` are masked before they reach it. Keep a held-out set of tasks the proposer has not seen to tell real improvements from overfitting.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Where things live：- `active/` the mounted harness: `systemprompt.md`, `guardrails.md`, `tool_guidance.md`, `LongTermMEMORY.md`, `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (+ `scripts/`). You can edit these by hand; the next Session mounts the edited version.
- `state/` `manifest.json`, `checkpoints/<runId>.json`, `harnesses/<versionId>/` snapshots, `sessions/` sidecars, `events.jsonl`.
- `experience/` `INDEX.md` and one folder per entry (`EXPERIENCE.md`, the harness snapshot it came from).

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Where things live：Each probe runs in `<tmp>/dshp-*/` with its own `DSH_HOME` (profile, credentials copied from the template profile, the candidate harness) and workspace, deleted when the probe ends. Stale directories left by a killed process are swept at the next start.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · What leaves your machine：- To the proposer endpoint: the task prompt, the current harness text, summaries of the reference runs (tool names, argument excerpts, error messages, a final-output excerpt with keys and private IPs redacted), and relevant experience entries. Only when `proposer.engine` is `llm`.
- From the probes: whatever the agent's model receives in a normal dsh Session, through the model rows of the template profile.
- Nothing else. There is no telemetry; the plugin never calls GitHub or npm.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Evaluation：See [`docs/evaluation-report.md`](docs/evaluation-report.md) for the real-model run (setup, per-task numbers, limitations). The two gates it reports:

- **G1**: with the same probe budget, does single-step Propose → Probe → Compose beat best-of-k on a held-out task set by more than the baseline's own variance?
- **G2**: does the cross-task experience library help on held-out tasks, measured by leave-one-out?
dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Evaluation：The unit tests (`npm test`) include a pipeline rehearsal with a mock executor; those numbers are not results and are never written into the report.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Known limits：- One evolution run spends 5 to 6 full agent runs plus one or two proposer calls. Budgets (`maxTokensPerIteration`, `maxWallTimeMs`, `probeTimeoutMs`) stop a run; they do not make it cheap.
- Probes inherit the template profile's `cordis.patch.yml` only; model rows passed to dsh with `--patch` at launch are not seen by the child process.
- Windows: child processes are killed with `taskkill /T`; a probe that is cancelled during a slow model call may take a few seconds to go away.
- The runtime stagnation detector (`enableRuntimeStagnation`) is optional and off by default.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · Development：```bash
npm test                    # unit tests, including a probe child-process test with a fake dsh binary
npm run eval                # pipeline rehearsal with the mock executor (not a result)
node eval/run-real-eval.mjs --config my-config.json   # real-model evaluation, resumable
```

Feedback and bug reports: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/Bear0117/dsh-plugin-recursive-harness/issues). MIT license.

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · 递归 Harness：[English](README.md) · 简体中文 · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md)

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）插件。模型权重完全不动，只演进 agent 的 **harness**，按 Google Research **Harness²**（[arXiv:2610.14224](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224)）的双层递归：

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · 递归 Harness：- **任务层：Propose → Probe → Compose。** 模型提出两个候选 harness（*general* 强化推理与工具纪律；*domain* 加入记忆、护栏与一个技能）。每个候选在隔离的 headless dsh 里、用任务工作区的副本跑一次。先看客观检查，再看行为指标（工具错误、步数、token），最后才是可选的模型裁判。互补的胜出者会合并后再验证一次；合并变差就退回最好的单一候选。
- **跨任务层：Reflector → 经验库。** 成功与失败的教训写成纯文本 Markdown 条目，之后的提案按严格时间序引用。

会被演进的：四段系统提示（`systemprompt`、`guardrails`、`tool_guidance`、`longTermMemory`）与候选技能（`SKILL.md` 加小脚本）。永远不动的：你的 `AGENTS.md`、`.dsh/`、`.git/`，以及 `lockedSurfaces` 列出的路径。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · 递归 Harness：**状态：实验性。** 在 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 上整条流程可跑，[`docs/evaluation-report.md`](docs/evaluation-report.md) 的评测是用真实模型在 12 题合成任务上跑出来的。用在自己的任务前，先读报告里的限制。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 你会看到什么：1. 装好插件后，每个新 Session 都带着当前启用的 harness 版本（四段各出现一次在系统提示里；`/harness inspect` 显示版本与挂载的技能）。
2. `/harness start gen-dev-01`（内置任务）或 `/harness start ./my-task.mjs` 在后台启动一轮演进：参考执行、提案、探针、比较、合并。`/harness status <runId>` 看进度，`/harness cancel <runId>` 停止并杀掉子进程。
3. 候选在客观检查上赢过基准、而且赢的幅度大于基准自己的方差时，才会成为启用版本。**新 Session** 会拿到它；运行中的 Session 不会被中途改掉。`/harness rollback [versionId]` 回退。
4. `/harness listExperience` 列出 reflector 留下的经验。
dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 你会看到什么：命令行有同一组命令：`npx dsh-recursive-harness inspect | start | status | cancel | rollback | listExperience`（状态默认在 `./.dsh-harness`；`--config` 接一个 JSON，字段和插件设置一样）。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 需求：- dsh 0.2.x。在 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2（Windows 11、Node.js 24.21）的 web profile 上测过；探针用 dsh 内置的 headless profile。
- Node.js 22.19 以上的 22 系列，或 24 以上（和 dsh 相同）。
- 一个**提案器端点**：任何 OpenAI 兼容的 chat completions 服务器（vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 或云端 API）。没设置之前，提案器是固定模板，不会有任何文字离开你的电脑。
- 探针用 `probe.templateProfile`（默认 `web`）那个 profile 的模型，或你在 `probe.provider`／`probe.model` 指定的模型。每次探针都是一次完整的 agent 运行，请估好预算。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness
```

用 npx 的话：`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`。之后重启 `dsh web`。启动时插件会打印 `[recursive-harness] ready: …`。

**更新：** `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugin-recursive-harness` 后重启。dsh 用 pnpm 装插件，刚发布的版本要满一天才会被选到；想马上更新就写明版本（`add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness@0.1.0`）。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 安装：**移除：** `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`，删掉 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `recursive-harness` 段落（如果有加），不想保留 harness 版本与经验库的话再删 `~/.dsh/recursive-harness/`。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 设置：设置放在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（web profile：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）。`id: recursive-harness` 的段落会替换插件的整份 `config`；没写到的键用 [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) 里的默认值。

```yaml
- id: recursive-harness
  config:
    proposer:
      engine: llm

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 自己的任务：任务文件是一个 ES module，export 一个任务（或 `tasks` 数组）。插件把 `workspaceFiles` 写进空工作区，用 `prompt` 跑 agent，再把最后输出交给 `objectiveCheck`：

```js
// my-task.mjs
export default {
  taskId: 'orders-report',
  split: 'dev',

提案器看不到 `expected`；`details` 里的数字送到提案器前会先遮掉。请留一组提案器没见过的保留任务，才能分辨真的进步和过拟合。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 东西放在哪：`$DSH_HOME/recursive-harness/`（默认 `~/.dsh/recursive-harness/`）：

- `active/` 挂载中的 harness：`systemprompt.md`、`guardrails.md`、`tool_guidance.md`、`LongTermMEMORY.md`、`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`（加 `scripts/`）。可以手动改，下一个 Session 就挂改过的版本。
- `state/` `manifest.json`、`checkpoints/<runId>.json`、`harnesses/<versionId>/` 快照、`sessions/` sidecar、`events.jsonl`。
- `experience/` `INDEX.md` 与每条一个文件夹（`EXPERIENCE.md`、来源的 harness 快照）。
dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 东西放在哪：每次探针在 `<tmp>/dshp-*/` 里跑，有自己的 `DSH_HOME`（profile、从模板 profile 复制的凭证、候选 harness）和工作区，跑完即删。进程被强杀留下的目录会在下次启动时清掉。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 什么会离开你的电脑：- 发到提案器端点：任务 prompt、当前的 harness 文字、参考执行的摘要（工具名、参数节选、错误信息、遮掉密钥与内网 IP 的最终输出节选）、相关经验条目。只在 `proposer.engine` 是 `llm` 时。
- 探针：和一般 dsh Session 一样，agent 的模型会收到什么就是什么，走模板 profile 的模型设置。
- 其他没有。没有遥测；插件不会连 GitHub 或 npm。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 评测：真实模型的评测（设置、逐题数字、限制）在 [`docs/evaluation-report.md`](docs/evaluation-report.md)。报告里的两个门槛：

- **G1**：同样的探针预算下，单步 Propose → Probe → Compose 在保留任务集上是否赢过 best-of-k，而且赢的幅度大于基准自己的方差？
- **G2**：跨任务经验库对保留任务有没有帮助（leave-one-out）？

单元测试（`npm test`）里有一个用模拟执行器的管线演练；那些数字不是结果，也不会写进报告。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 已知限制：- 一轮演进要花 5 到 6 次完整的 agent 运行，加上一到两次提案器调用。预算（`maxTokensPerIteration`、`maxWallTimeMs`、`probeTimeoutMs`）只会把它停下来，不会让它变便宜。
- 探针只继承模板 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`；启动 dsh 时用 `--patch` 加的模型设置，子进程看不到。
- Windows：子进程用 `taskkill /T` 杀；在慢的模型调用中途取消，可能要几秒才会消失。
- 运行期停滞检测（`enableRuntimeStagnation`）是可选项，默认关。

dsh-plugin-recursive-harness README · 开发：```bash
npm test                    # 单元测试，含用假 dsh 可执行文件的探针子进程测试
npm run eval                # 模拟执行器的管线演练（不是结果）
node eval/run-real-eval.mjs --config my-config.json   # 真实模型评测，可续跑
```

意见与问题反馈：[GitHub issues](https://github.com/Bear0117/dsh-plugin-recursive-harness/issues)。MIT 许可。
